title: About Language & Co
paragraphs: Founded in 2010, Language & Co changed the way people learn languages for the better. Our method mixes full immersion with the latest edtech so learning actually feels natural.
Our courses are built by certified teachers with years of experience teaching English and other languages. Every student gets a study plan tailored just for them.
Students of all ages and levels find exactly what they need to level up. Small-group classes mean you get real attention, so you progress fast.
